item.case_name: Text on screen in a clip
item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Gardener Interview Name Caption

turns.text: Make a silent 7-second widescreen clip of a fictional woman standing in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera. Put “Maya Chen” with “Community Gardener” underneath at the bottom left from second 1 through the end. White lettering on a dark backing, not over her face. No other text.

item.tests: Checks an exact two-line lower third that stays readable and correctly placed over a moving subject.

answer_sheet.Person and setting: A fictional woman in a community garden; her appearance is your call.
answer_sheet.Name and role: Maya Chen on the first line; Community Gardener underneath. English, without quotation marks.
answer_sheet.Caption appearance and timing: Bottom left, white lettering on a dark backing, clear of her face, appearing at second 1 and staying through the end.
answer_sheet.Mood and movement: Friendly and natural; she smiles and turns slightly toward the camera.

must_haves: A woman is visibly in a community garden, smiling and turning slightly toward the camera.
The lower third reads exactly 'Maya Chen' above 'Community Gardener', with no additional text.
Both lines use legible white lettering on a dark backing at the bottom left, with no clipping.
The lower third does not cover her face and remains stable and readable as she moves.
The caption is absent during the opening second and present from approximately second 1 through the end.
The delivered clip is silent, 16:9 and approximately 7 seconds long.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a silent 7-second widescreen live-action-style clip. A fictional adult woman named Maya Chen stands in a welcoming community garden among shared raised vegetable beds, leafy plants, and flowers, in soft natural afternoon light. Warm, peaceful, nostalgic neighborhood atmosphere. Medium-wide waist-up composition with the woman positioned slightly right of center, face in upper right area, leaving bottom-left negative space. She smiles warmly and slowly turns her shoulders and head slightly toward the camera with natural subtle movement. Stable camera, continuous shot, no cuts. Precisely timed lower-third title: from 0.0 seconds until 1.0 seconds there is NO text. At exactly 1.0 seconds a dark opaque rectangular backing appears at the bottom left with comfortable edge margins, containing white clean sans-serif lettering on two lines: first line exactly "Maya Chen"; second line exactly "Community Gardener". Keep this two-line title static, legible and visible from second 1 through the end at second 7. The dark backing and white letters remain well away from her face. No other text, no captions, no signs with writing, no logos. No speech, music or sound; silent output.
